name: Tesamorelin / Ipamorelin
used_for: Marketed by telemedicine and peptide clinics as a visceral fat and growth hormone stack for body composition. Tesamorelin alone has an approved indication that does not cover this use.
summary: Tesamorelin / Ipamorelin pairs a growth hormone releasing hormone analog with a ghrelin-receptor peptide. Tesamorelin alone is FDA-approved for a specific indication, but the pair is not an approved product and no combination-specific human study was found in the sources reviewed. A telemedicine article describes tesamorelin's label as stating it is not indicated for weight loss management. The detailed information is on the pages for Tesamorelin and Ipamorelin; formulations vary by seller. The combination's side effects are not separately characterized.

side_effects.text: FDA lists ipamorelin acetate in category 2 for 503B compounding and states that compounded drugs containing it may pose risk for immunogenicity for certain routes of administration due to the potential for aggregation or peptide-related impurities. This statement concerns the component, not the combination.
side_effects.label: research

internet_claims.claim: A telemedicine company's article calls tesamorelin plus ipamorelin the visceral fat stack, notes that tesamorelin is FDA-approved only for HIV-associated lipodystrophy, and says its label states it is not indicated for weight loss management.

research.summary: FDA web page on bulk drug substances for compounding that may present significant safety risks (content dated 22 April 2026, fetched 2026-10-01).
research.finding: FDA lists ipamorelin acetate in category 2 for 503B outsourcing facilities and states that compounded drugs containing it may pose risk for immunogenicity for certain routes of administration due to the potential for aggregation or peptide-related impurities.

research.summary: Study of growth hormone secretion in healthy men in relation to sleep and time of day, using deconvolution of frequent blood samples (Van Cauter et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab).
research.finding: A GH pulse began within 30 minutes of sleep onset in every profile with normal sleep, and about 70% of pulses during sleep were tied to slow-wave sleep.

dose.summary: No study of tesamorelin and ipamorelin given together was found. Sellers describe combined doses of about 1 to 2 mg tesamorelin with 100 to 300 micrograms (mcg) of ipamorelin per injection. These doses are not from a trial, and formulations vary by seller.

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, says tesamorelin 1 to 2 mg plus ipamorelin 100 to 300 mcg per injection, and that no peer-reviewed dosing protocol exists for the combined stack.
items.label: internet

items.text: Pantheon Peptides, a peptide seller, describes its 5 mg tesamorelin and 2 mg ipamorelin stack as 1 mg tesamorelin with 100 to 200 mcg ipamorelin daily.
items.label: internet

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, describes a single vial holding 10 mg tesamorelin and 5 mg ipamorelin, a fixed 2 to 1 ratio in every unit drawn, and says no randomized trial has validated its escalation, weekly rhythm or pause.
items.label: internet

items.text: Beverly Hills Rejuvenation Center, a medical spa that sells peptides, says blend vials come in ratios like 1:1 (5 mg/5 mg) or higher in tesamorelin (10 mg/3 mg).
items.label: internet

timing.summary: Online sources favor bedtime to match the body's own overnight growth hormone (GH) pulse. Bedtime dosing of this combination has not been tested.

items.text: The body's own largest GH pulse comes shortly after falling asleep, during deep sleep. This is natural GH, not the effect of this combination; no trial has compared bedtime with daytime dosing.
items.label: research

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, says the stack is typically taken before sleep when natural GH pulses are highest.
items.label: internet

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, says one injection delivers both peptides, given at night.
items.label: internet

items.text: Beverly Hills Rejuvenation Center, a medical spa that sells peptides, says the blend is taken before bed, and that some people also dose in the morning.
items.label: internet

fasting.summary: No study tested meal timing for this combination. Sellers say to inject on an empty stomach, at least 90 minutes to 2 hours after eating.

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, says to inject at least 2 hours after the last meal.
items.label: internet

items.text: Pantheon Peptides, a peptide seller, says to dose on an empty stomach, at least 90 minutes after the last meal.
items.label: internet

items.text: Beverly Hills Rejuvenation Center, a medical spa that sells peptides, says to take the blend before bed on an empty stomach.
items.label: internet

frequency.summary: No study tested how often to give this combination. Sellers describe once daily dosing, often 5 days on and 2 days off.

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, says dosing more than once daily has not been validated in any published human study.
items.label: internet

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, describes 5 days on and 2 days off.
items.label: internet

items.text: Beverly Hills Rejuvenation Center, a medical spa that sells peptides, describes 5 days on and 2 days off.
items.label: internet

cycle_length.summary: No study tested a combined cycle length. Sellers describe cycles of about 8 to 12 weeks, or 3 months, followed by a break.

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, describes 3 months of dosing followed by a 2 month pause, and says no randomized trial has validated this pause.
items.label: internet

items.text: Beverly Hills Rejuvenation Center, a medical spa that sells peptides, describes cycles of 8 to 12 weeks on with a break.
items.label: internet

storage_and_handling.summary: Online sources disagree on whether the two peptides can be mixed. One says to combine them in a syringe only just before injecting and not to store the mixture, while another sells them pre-combined in one vial. No study of stability of a mixed product was found.

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, says to reconstitute each peptide separately, draw ipamorelin then tesamorelin into the same syringe, inject immediately and not store the mixture.
items.label: internet

items.text: Pantheon Peptides, a peptide seller, says both peptides can be taken together at night in the same syringe, and that reconstituted vials should be refrigerated and used within 30 to 45 days.
items.label: internet

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, says its product arrives pre-combined in a single vial, so nothing is combined at home.
items.label: internet

mechanism.summary: A seller describes the pair as acting at two points on the same pathway. No study shows how the combination behaves in people.

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, says growth hormone releasing hormone (GHRH) turns on the accelerator while a ghrelin agonist releases the brake.
items.label: internet

best_documented_effect.summary: No study of tesamorelin and ipamorelin given together was found. Sellers say no human randomized trial has tested the combination.

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, says no published human randomized trial has tested the combination directly.
items.label: internet

items.text: A telemedicine company's article calls tesamorelin plus ipamorelin the visceral fat stack. It notes that tesamorelin on its own is FDA-approved only for HIV-associated lipodystrophy and says its label states it is not indicated for weight loss management. This describes the tesamorelin component.
items.label: internet

side_effect_groups.title: Regulator warning
side_effect_groups.summary: FDA lists ipamorelin, one component, in a compounding risk category. This is not about the combination itself.

items.text: FDA lists ipamorelin acetate in category 2 for 503B compounding and states that compounded drugs containing it may pose risk for immunogenicity for certain routes of administration due to the potential for aggregation or peptide-related impurities. This statement concerns the component, not the combination.
items.label: research

side_effect_groups.title: Online reports
side_effect_groups.summary: The combination's side effects have not been studied. Sellers list effects they attribute to the peptide types.

items.text: FormBlends, a compounded-peptide seller, lists fluid retention, glucose elevation, joint or muscle pain, carpal tunnel syndrome and injection site reactions as class effects.
items.label: internet

items.text: Perfect B, an aesthetic clinic, lists glucose, fluid retention and immunogenicity, and says peripheral edema, joint pain and carpal tunnel symptoms are documented class effects.
items.label: internet

items.text: Pantheon Peptides, a peptide seller, lists mild injection site irritation and temporary water retention, bloating or flushing.
items.label: internet
